name: RB-I13: Change opens the operator sheet and cancels cleanly
description: Tap Change on an assigned card. Inspect the operator list (names, availability, disabled rows). Dismiss without selecting. The card must still show the original operator. Committing a change is RB-S11.

Tap Get started on onboarding slide 2
Read Get OTP enabled on the clickable outer View
Press digit keys without replacing the field
Check Quick Booking title and Close are visible
Check Home identity (greeting or Current Earning, not Quick Booking app bar)
Check Request to extend time dialog
Check Quick Booking title and Close are visible
Check Quick Booking title and Close are visible
Check rental Timer label is visible
Tap Close (clickable outer View, not the inner icon)
Check Quick Booking title and Close are visible
Check Request to extend time dialog
Check Home identity (greeting or Current Earning, not Quick Booking app bar)
Check rental Home stat cards from 21 Sep dump
Tap nth See all (0 Active Fleet, 1 Upcoming, 2 Booking Orders)
Check Rental Bookings identity (three tabs + a bookings header)
Check Upcoming / Active / Completed tabs are visible
Tap first Change on Upcoming (clickable TextView)
Check Request to extend time dialog
